TabularClassificationTask.name: TabularClassificationTask
TabularClassificationTask.description:
Tabular classification in machine learning involves predicting categorical
    labels for structured data organized in tabular form (rows and columns).
    Models are trained to learn patterns and relationships in the data, enabling
    accurate classification of new instances.

TextClassificationTask.name: TextClassificationTask
TextClassificationTask.description:
Text classification is an essential Natural Language Processing (NLP) task that
    involves automatically assigning pre-defined categories or labels to text documents
    based on their content. It serves as the foundation for applications like sentiment
    analysis, spam filtering, topic classification, and document categorization.

TranslationTask.name: TranslationTask
TranslationTask.description:
The translation task is natural language processing (NLP) task that involves
    converting text or speech from one language into another language while
    preserving the meaning and context.

RegressionTask.name: RegressionTask
RegressionTask.description:
Regression in machine learning involves predicting continuous values for
    structured data organized in tabular form (rows and columns).
    Models are trained to learn patterns and relationships in the data,
    enabling accurate prediction of new instances.

TextToImageGenerationTask.name: TextToImageGenerationTask
TextToImageGenerationTask.description: This task generates images based on the provided input text.

TextToTextGenerationTask.name: TextToTextGenerationTask
TextToTextGenerationTask.description: This task uses a large language model (LLM) to generate text from a given prompt.

ControlNetTask.name: ControlNetTask
ControlNetTask.description: This task generates images based on the provided input text and image.

RAGTask.name: RAGTask
RAGTask.description: This task generates a text response based on documents provided and chat.
